Drama Skills

面向编剧、漫剧工作室和编导的 AI 短剧创作工作流：十二个技能，从一个点子或一部原著做到分集剧本、分镜、图片/视频提示词和成片。

项目主页  ·  安装  ·  看看它的输出  ·  English

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/640db65d-bd57-4924-83de-9c5852c1db26 上面这段 68 秒竖屏样片是《让你管账号》第 1 集开头：由一部 20 章小说改编，拆成 20 镜逐镜生成后剪成成片，字幕、系统面板与音效在剪辑阶段叠加。视频生成成本约 40 元。 ### 更多样片：打戏、群戏、水墨漫剧 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f67e2e04-52e7-42a9-a4a0-e2864ff0f51e ## 这是什么 Drama Skills 覆盖 AI 短剧与漫剧从点子或原著到成片的全流程：**原著分析 → 分集剧本 → 视觉设定 → 图片提示词与分镜 → 视频提示词 → 确认后生产 → 剪辑成片 → 审查**。它以 12 个技能的形式装进你常用的编程 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity 及其他支持 Agent Skill 规范的环境），直接使用当前 Agent 的模型写作。 这套技能脱胎于我们漫剧工作室的日常产线：2025 年以来累计做过上千个 AI 短剧和漫剧项目，近 8 万行代码的一体化图形工具跟不上模型迭代后，我们把工程做法和提示词经验提炼成这套技能，改用 Agent CLI 加纯文本文件管项目，内部工具只留排队生成。 - **五份 Markdown 记录创作决定** — 按阶段维护 `剧本.md`、`视觉设定.md`、`分镜.md`、`图片提示词.md`、`视频提示词.md`，剪辑时加一份 `剪辑单.md`；只做部分阶段就交付对应文档。 - **白纸黑字防跨镜穿帮** — 跨镜不变的穿着造型写成可原样贴入提示词的固定短语（连戏锁与锁定词），每镜首帧写明出场设定，检查脚本自动核对跨文档引用。 - **先看预览、确认后再花钱生成** — 图片、视频（支持单镜与 `GROUP-*` 多镜合生）、配音和配乐任务均支持整批预览，在文件里列清数量、内容、参考图与参数，明确确认后再批量调用外部接口；平台密钥留在项目外，文档与前置技能不绑定特定平台。 - **成片剪辑也在套件里** — 剪辑技能逐段写明入出点取舍，字幕逐字取自剧本，统一响度后导出成片；检查与测量脚本只列核对结果和实测数据，不替人做创作判断。 > **创作指导层与自动化脚本的边界**：各技能中的创作方法、剧本/分镜/提示词规范与审查视角不绑定语言、画幅或目录布局，可以直接用于任意语言或已有项目；本地自动化脚本（跨文档检查、创作台、生产交接与剪辑渲染）目前面向标准中文项目结构，要求使用上述五份中文文档与 `剪辑单.md` 的约定文件名及中文 Markdown 字段。 ## 安装 前提：已在用 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity 或其他支持 Agent Skill 规范的编程 Agent，终端可执行 `npx`（Node.js）。 ```bash npx skills add zenstory-ai/drama-skills -y -g ``` `-g` 为全局安装，去掉则只装到当前目录；**更新时重跑同一条命令即可**。带脚本的 7 个技能需要 **Python 3.9 或更高版本**（其余 5 个纯知识文档技能零运行依赖），`short-drama-edit`（剪辑成片）与 `short-drama-breakdown`（对标视频测量/反推）另需安装 `ffmpeg` / `ffprobe`；启用可选 Remotion 复杂画面文字面板或动态字幕叠层时另需 `Node.js` / `npm` / `npx`（纯普通字卡场景支持 `--screen-text-mode` 降级至 `ffmpeg` 直出，无需安装 Node/Remotion）。 支持直接导入 GitHub 仓库的平台（如 WorkBuddy，见社区整理的[完整用法](https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2088046501696222384)），也可以直接对 Agent 说： ``` 安装这些技能 https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills ```
手动软链安装（可安装全部，也可只链需要的技能） ```bash git clone https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills.git && cd drama-skills # Claude Code mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills" for skill in skills/*; do ln -s "$PWD/$skill" "$HOME/.claude/skills/$(basename "$skill")" done # Codex mkdir -p "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills" for skill in skills/*; do ln -s "$PWD/$skill" "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/$(basename "$skill")" done # Antigravity（CLI / IDE / App，全局安装） mkdir -p "$HOME/.gemini/config/skills" for skill in skills/*; do ln -s "$PWD/$skill" "$HOME/.gemini/config/skills/$(basename "$skill")" done ``` 每个技能目录都可独立安装；只用某一项能力时软链对应目录即可。`short-drama` 负责项目初始化、阶段调度与本地创作台。如果只想在单个项目里启用，Antigravity 也支持把所需技能链接到项目根目录的 `.agents/skills/`（在 Antigravity 里直接打开本仓库副本时，`.agents/skills.json` 会自动加载全部 12 个技能）；在 Antigravity CLI（`agy`）中新增链接后运行 `/skills reload` 即可生效。
也可在 [ClawHub](https://clawhub.ai/) 中查找安装（清单见 [`.clawhub/publish.json`](.clawhub/publish.json)）。技能本身统一使用宿主中立的技能名（如 `short-drama`、`short-drama-write`），调用前缀随运行环境而变：Claude Code 与 Antigravity 用 `/short-drama`，Codex 用 `$short-drama`，其他支持 Agent Skill 规范的环境直接用技能名或自然语言描述任务；下文示例统一以 `$` 为例，按所用宿主替换或省略前缀即可。 > 版本变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) 与 [Releases](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/releases)；旧项目升级见[「升级到新版本后要做什么」](#升级到新版本后要做什么)。 ## 快速开始 按实际项目修改下面的请求即可发送给 Agent： ``` # 0. 有原著时（可选）：先抽样快评，再决定要不要整本拆 用 $short-drama-novel-analyze 快评 输入/这本小说.txt，先告诉我值不值得拆 # 有对标剧或参考视频时（可选）：拆解节奏差距，或把成片视频反推成剧本与制作文档 用 $short-drama-breakdown 拆解 输入/对标/ 里的标杆剧并对照本项目节奏差距（也可直接把视频反推成标准《剧本.md》） # 已有多集完整剧本时（可选）：先识别分集边界，逐集读取并续做分集大纲 用 $short-drama-develop 从 输入/剧本完整版.txt 生成分集大纲；先识别分集方式，不要整稿塞进上下文 # 1. 新建项目 用 $short-drama 初始化一个都市打脸题材的短剧项目，竖屏 9:16 # 2. 写第一集 用 $short-drama-write 写第 1 集：外卖员在高档餐厅被经理羞辱，亮出集团董事身份 # 3. 整理视觉设定，写提示词与分镜（可在同一条请求内连续完成） 用 $short-drama-assets 从第 1 集整理人物、场景和道具设定 需要统一全剧画风时，可选用 $short-drama 做视觉定调（Lookdev） 用 $short-drama-image-prompts 为已定稿的人物、场景和道具写参考图提示词 用 $short-drama-storyboard 给第 1 集拆分镜并写首帧提示词 用 $short-drama-video-prompts 把分镜逐镜写成视频提示词（同场相邻短镜可按需合并为 GROUP-* 多镜合生分组） # 指定目标视频模型并要求跨镜一致时，一并说明参考图绑定方式： 用 $short-drama-video-prompts 按 MiniMax H3 写第 1 集视频提示词；先在项目里找已有角色图、场景图、道具图和本镜起始帧绑成参考，缺哪张列出来，不要改成文生视频 # 参考图在外部界面出、不进项目时，让技能写出逐镜挂图计划： 用 $short-drama-video-prompts 按 MiniMax H3 写第 1 集视频提示词；参考图我自己挂，逐镜写清挂哪几张、什么顺序、每张管什么 # 4. 明确确认后投产（支持单条或整批确认与断点续跑） 用 $short-drama-produce 批量预览第 1 集已定稿的图片、视频（含 GROUP-* 合生分组）、配音或配乐任务；等我确认后再执行 # 5. 剪成成片 用 $short-drama-edit 把第 1 集已生成的镜头剪成成片，逐段写清入出点理由 # 6. 按需审查 用 $short-drama-review 审查第 1 集的剧本与提示词 ``` 从小说原著起步、首轮只交文字稿时： > 读一下 `输入/故事.txt`，先理出不能改的关键设定、人物动机和前期要藏住的悬念，再给出一套分集方案（别直接拿章节数当集数）。这轮只写第 1 集剧本，并挑三个关键镜头写清起止动作、手部姿态、持物和视线方向；先只交文字稿，不生图、生视频或配音。 ## 看看它的输出 下面节选来自仓库样例与实测运行，省略处标为「……」。原著快评回填对照、设定兑现表、剪辑实测与模型摸底记录见[真实产出节选](docs/real-outputs.md)。 ### 一集写出来是什么样 公开样例 [《让你管账号》EP001](examples/creator-first/EP001/) 中，同一个镜头在四份文档里各管一层。剧本只写戏剧动作与对白： ```markdown [OS] 其他军团的人：火箭军？四个号，加起来四个粉吧。 笔记本的扬声器里一片哄笑。桌后，周薄森对着屏幕坐得笔直，脸绷着。桌前，江晨双手撑着桌沿，猛地回神。 ``` `视觉设定.md` 给跨镜不变的穿着加上「连戏锁」，「锁定词」是可原样贴入提示词的固定短语： ```markdown - 连戏锁：LOCK-JIANGCHEN-DRESS《江晨松枝绿常服》（镜头：SHOT-EP001-002、SHOT-EP001-003、SHOT-EP001-007、……； 图片提示词项：IMG-JIANGCHEN-SHEET）· 锁定词：pine-green lapel service jacket ``` `分镜.md` 写明这一镜的起止画面与运镜动机；「首帧提示词」只画开场定格，原样带入锁定词： ```markdown ## SHOT-EP001-002 · 四个号，四个粉 - 运镜：缓推，哄笑声最响时开始，越过笔记本背面推向桌后，停在周薄森绷紧的脸；这阵笑是冲他去的。 - 起点：周薄森面对笔记本坐得笔直，右手搭在茶杯旁；江晨双手掌心朝下撑在玻璃桌沿，眼神涣散。 - 终点：画面停在周薄森绷紧的脸与屏幕冷光；江晨仍撑着桌沿，留在画右边缘。 ### 首帧提示词 > 9:16 vertical two-person medium shot in a present-day army arts-troupe office, framed at chest height: Jiangchen, a lean > young man in a pine-green lapel service jacket, stands mid-ground on frame right …… with both palms flat on the glass and a > dazed, unfocused look; Zhoubosen, a broad square-faced middle-aged officer, sits bolt upright behind the desk …… facing a > thin silver laptop whose lid faces the camera, …… his right hand beside a double-walled glass tea tumbler on a dark round > coaster; …… no text, no logo. ``` `视频提示词.md` 只写起点到终点之间的动作推进与运镜，整段复制进生成界面就能用： ```markdown ## MOTION-EP001-002 · 四个号，四个粉 ### 可复制提示词 > …… Laughter keeps pouring out of the laptop's small speaker. The seated officer's jaw tightens and his back straightens a > little more. The young man blinks once and his eyes snap into focus. At the loudest point of the laughter, the camera moves > steadily forward past the back of the laptop and stops when the seated officer's tight face fills the middle of the frame, > the young man remaining at the right edge. …… ``` 四份原文：[`剧本.md`](examples/creator-first/EP001/剧本.md) · [`视觉设定.md`](examples/creator-first/EP001/视觉设定.md) · [`分镜.md`](examples/creator-first/EP001/分镜.md) · [`视频提示词.md`](examples/creator-first/EP001/视频提示词.md)。 ### 漏项和不一致会自动报错 `creator_markdown_check.py` 遵循**软门禁原则**：只有 100% 确定性的机械与安全问题（跨文档 ID 悬空、路径缺失、时长不等、槽位语法错误）才输出阻断级 `ERROR`，启发式事项仅输出 `WARNING` 提醒 Agent 复核。把样例故意改坏两处——把 SHOT-002「出场设定」里的「周薄森」写错成「周博森」、把 MOTION-003 的时长从 2 秒改成 3 秒——报错会直接指出问题镜头与修法： ```text ERROR: SHOT-EP001-002: 出场设定指向不存在的《视觉设定.md》条目: 人物「周博森」 ERROR: SHOT-EP001-003: 分镜时长 2 秒与视频提示词 3 秒不一致；视频提示词时长必须与分镜一致 ``` ## 十二个技能 各阶段按需调用：只出文字稿时写到目标阶段即可交付，任意现有文稿都可单独送审；静态漫剧可从首帧图片与配音直接进入生产和剪辑。 ```mermaid flowchart LR classDef phase fill:#e8f4fd,color:#1a1a2e,stroke:#4a9be8,stroke-width:1px classDef final fill:#fce4ec,color:#333,stroke:#e57373,stroke-width:1px nva["原著分析
$short-drama-novel-analyze"]:::phase brk["对标拆解
$short-drama-breakdown"]:::phase dev["故事开发
$short-drama-develop"]:::phase write["分集剧本
$short-drama-write"]:::phase assets["视觉设定
$short-drama-assets"]:::phase img["图片提示词
$short-drama-image-prompts"]:::phase sb["分镜/首帧
$short-drama-storyboard"]:::phase vid["视频提示词
$short-drama-video-prompts"]:::phase prod["确认后生产
$short-drama-produce"]:::phase cut["剪辑成片
$short-drama-edit"]:::phase rev["审查
$short-drama-review"]:::final pkg["成片与交付包"]:::final nva -.有原著时.-> dev brk -.有对标剧时.-> dev cut -.成片对照.-> brk dev -.可选.-> write --> assets assets --> img assets --> sb --> vid img --> prod vid --> prod prod --> cut --> rev --> pkg ``` | 技能 | 职责 | |---|---| | `short-drama` | 项目初始化、阶段调度、视觉定调（Lookdev）与本地创作台 | | `short-drama-novel-analyze` | 长篇原著抽样快评、章节索引、逐章梳理、脉络节奏分析与分集建议 | | `short-drama-develop` | 原著改编、多集整稿切分与续拆、核心矛盾设定、分集大纲、导演阐述与题材钩子手册 | | `short-drama-write` | 单集剧情目标、因果节点、可拍分集剧本与片场制作稿格式 | | `short-drama-assets` | 人物与换装造型、场景与机位朝向、道具状态变化、角色声线及跨镜连戏锁 | | `short-drama-image-prompts` | 视觉定调风格帧、角色/场景/道具参考图提示词与局部改图说明 | | `short-drama-storyboard` | 场次站位调度与多机位比选、剧本逐句落镜、起止画面与首尾帧提示词 | | `short-drama-video-prompts` | 单镜动作推进、多人调度与视线转移、运镜、声音、`GROUP-*` 多镜合生、补拍说明及跨镜配乐表 | | `short-drama-produce` | 单条或整批预览图片/视频（含 `GROUP-*` 合生分组）/配音/配乐任务，明确确认后批量调用接口生成并支持断点续跑；内置支持 Seedance、OpenAI GPT Image、MiniMax H3 / Speech / Music | | `short-drama-edit` | 挑选单镜或 `GROUP-*` 合生素材可用区间、写明入出点取舍、核对台词、烧录字幕并统一响度，生成剪辑单与成片 | | `short-drama-breakdown` | 按集长、镜长、对白密度、开场与集尾拆解对标剧并比对本项目差距；支持将参考剧集反推为剧本、设定与提示词 | | `short-drama-review` | 结构与剧情审查；结合实拍出片效果排查设定与提示词偏差并给出修订建议 | ## 本地短剧创作台 在 Agent 里一句话启动（Claude Code 与 Antigravity 如下，Codex 写作 `$short-drama dashboard`）： ``` /short-drama dashboard ``` 原生支持 macOS、Linux、WSL 与 Windows。创作台默认在后台独立运行（`--detach`），会话期间链接持续有效；可用 `--status` 查看当前地址，`--stop` 关闭服务。服务仅监听本机，项目内容不上传。 完稿后可用 `project_tool.py export --out <项目外目录>` 导出交付包，把每集现有的五份创作文档、`剪辑单.md` 与 `制作成果/` 汇总成带清单和校验和的目录（只交文本时加 `--no-media`），并可用 `project_tool.py verify <导出目录>` 复核导出清单与文件校验和。 ## 常见问题 ### 参考图在外部工具里生成、不放进项目目录，还能写图生视频提示词吗？ 可以，这正是默认方式。项目里没有现成图片时，分镜会按出场人物、场景、道具和起始帧生成逐镜挂图计划，视频提示词照常按图生视频写出，并标明每镜挂哪几张图、按什么顺序挂、每张管什么；只有让套件直接调用接口生成时才需要把实图放进项目。详见[漫剧创作全流程指引](docs/comic-drama-workflow.md)。 ### 视频生成提交后中断了，需要重投吗？ 先找回原任务，避免重复扣费。内置生成接口拿到平台任务 ID 后会立即保存到本地；中断后先让 `$short-drama-produce` 运行 `audit` 定位未完结任务，再用 `collect` 取回已有结果。确认原任务已在平台侧失败且无结果可取后，再重新预览确认重投。详见[确认后生产](skills/short-drama-produce/SKILL.md)。 ### 需要本地 GPU 吗？生图和生视频怎么计费？ 不需要 GPU。剧本、分镜和提示词由你正在用的编程 Agent 模型完成，本地脚本负责索引、校验、任务交接与剪辑渲染（剪辑成片需本机装有 `ffmpeg` / `ffprobe`）。媒体生成使用你在项目外配置的平台密钥调用外部接口，按对应平台计费，每批任务都须预览确认后才执行。 ### 静态漫剧（关键帧切换 + 配音）也要写视频提示词吗？ 不用。分镜首帧与图片提示词可直接进入生产预览与配音剪辑，跳过视频提示词环节。完整串法见[漫剧创作全流程指引](docs/comic-drama-workflow.md)。 ### 升级到新版本后要做什么？ 重跑同一条安装命令即可更新技能。若旧项目跨越了字段或校验规则调整，按 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) 中的升级说明修改文档后，对每集跑一次 `creator_markdown_check.py`（已剪辑剧集再跑一次 `edit_tool.py check`）核对即可。 ## Drama Skills

An AI short-drama creation workflow for screenwriters, motion-comic studios, and directors: twelve skills that take an idea or a source novel to episode scripts, storyboards, image/video prompts, and a finished cut.

Video generation cost about ¥40. ### More samples: a fight, an ensemble scene, a 2D ink-wash comic https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f67e2e04-52e7-42a9-a4a0-e2864ff0f51e ## What it is Drama Skills covers the AI short-drama and motion-comic pipeline from idea or source novel to finished cut: **source analysis → episode script → visual design → image prompts and storyboard → video prompts → confirmed production → editing → review**. It installs as 12 skills into the coding agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or any runtime supporting the Agent Skill spec) and writes with that agent's model. These skills grew out of our motion-comic studio's production line: after more than a thousand AI short-drama and motion-comic projects since 2025, a nearly 80,000-line all-in-one GUI could no longer keep up with model iteration, so we distilled our workflows and prompt craft into plain-file agent skills and kept only the generation queue in-house. - **Five Markdown files record creative decisions** — each episode maintains the files its stages need: `剧本.md` (script), `视觉设定.md` (visual design), `分镜.md` (storyboard), `图片提示词.md` (image prompts), and `视频提示词.md` (video prompts), plus `剪辑单.md` (cut list) when editing; when you run only part of the workflow, deliver only the documents for the stages you run. - **Written settings keep shots consistent** — any look that must hold across shots gets a continuity lock with a fixed phrase pasted verbatim into prompts, every first-frame prompt declares its on-screen settings, and a checker verifies cross-file references. - **Preview and confirm before spending money** — image, video (single shots or `GROUP-*` multi-shot groups), voice, and music jobs can be previewed as a batch first, listing exact counts, prompts, references, and parameters before calling external APIs; API keys stay outside the project and upstream files stay provider-neutral. - **Editing is part of the suite** — the editing skill records the reason for every in and out point, pulls subtitles verbatim from the script, normalizes loudness, and renders the episode; check and measurement scripts report objective results without making creative calls for you. > **Language-agnostic creative guidance vs. automated scripts**: The creative workflows, craft guides, prompt-writing methods, and review rubrics are language- and layout-agnostic—you can use them in English or any other language, aspect ratio, or existing directory structure without running local scripts. The bundled automated scripts (cross-document checks, local creator workspace, production handoff, and edit rendering) currently expect the standard Chinese five-document filenames (`剧本.md`, `视觉设定.md`, `分镜.md`, `图片提示词.md`, `视频提示词.md`), `剪辑单.md`, and their Chinese Markdown field structure. ## Install Prerequisite: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or another coding agent supporting the Agent Skill spec, with `npx` (Node.js) available in your terminal. ```bash npx skills add zenstory-ai/drama-skills -y -g ``` `-g` installs globally (omit it to install into the current directory only); **re-run the same command to update**. The 7 script-backed skills require **Python 3.9 or newer** (the other 5 documentation-only skills have no runtime prerequisites); `short-drama-edit` (rendering cuts) and `short-drama-breakdown` (benchmark video measurement and reverse-engineering) also need `ffmpeg` / `ffprobe` on `PATH`; optional Remotion complex screen-text panels or dynamic-subtitle overlays additionally need `Node.js` / `npm` / `npx` (plain title cards support `--screen-text-mode` `ffmpeg` fallback without Node/Remotion). On platforms that import skills directly from a GitHub URL (such as WorkBuddy; see the [community walkthrough](https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2088046501696222384) in Chinese), you can tell your agent: ``` Install this skill suite: https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills ```
Manual symlink install (all skills, or only the ones you need) ```bash git clone https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills.git && cd drama-skills # Claude Code mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills" for skill in skills/*; do ln -s "$PWD/$skill" "$HOME/.claude/skills/$(basename "$skill")" done # Codex mkdir -p "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills" for skill in skills/*; do ln -s "$PWD/$skill" "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/$(basename "$skill")" done # Antigravity (CLI / IDE / App, global) mkdir -p "$HOME/.gemini/config/skills" for skill in skills/*; do ln -s "$PWD/$skill" "$HOME/.gemini/config/skills/$(basename "$skill")" done ``` Each skill directory is standalone; link only the directories you need. `short-drama` provides project setup, stage routing, and the local creator workspace. To scope skills to a single project in Antigravity, link them into `/.agents/skills/` instead (opening a clone of this repository in Antigravity loads all 12 skills automatically via `.agents/skills.json`); in Antigravity CLI (`agy`), run `/skills reload` after adding symlinks.
Skills are also listed on [ClawHub](https://clawhub.ai/) (manifest: [`.clawhub/publish.json`](.clawhub/publish.json)). The skills themselves use host-neutral skill names (such as `short-drama` and `short-drama-write`), while invocation prefixes differ by runtime: Claude Code and Antigravity use `/short-drama`, Codex uses `$short-drama`, and other Agent Skill runtimes accept the plain skill name or natural language; examples below use `$`, so adapt or omit the prefix for your runtime. > Release notes are in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) and [Releases](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/releases); for existing projects, see [What do I do after upgrading?](#what-do-i-do-after-upgrading). ## Quick start Adapt any of these prompts to your project and send it to your agent: ``` # 0. With a source novel (optional): sample triage before committing to a full pass Use $short-drama-novel-analyze to triage 输入/novel.txt and tell me whether it is worth adapting # With benchmark dramas or reference videos (optional): measure pacing gaps, or reverse-engineer video into scripts and docs Use $short-drama-breakdown to benchmark 输入/对标/ against this project (or reverse-engineer a reference video directly into a standard 剧本.md) # With a complete multi-episode script (optional): detect episode boundaries and build the outline incrementally Use $short-drama-develop to build the episode outline from 输入/full-screenplay.txt; detect episode boundaries first without loading the whole script into context # 1. New project Use $short-drama to init a vertical 9:16 urban face-slapping short-drama project # 2. Write episode 1 Use $short-drama-write to write EP001: a delivery rider humiliated by the manager at a luxury restaurant reveals he is a director of the group # 3. Organize visual design, write prompts and storyboards (can run in a single request) Use $short-drama-assets to organize character, location, and prop settings from EP001 When the overall visual style needs alignment, optionally use $short-drama for Look Development Use $short-drama-image-prompts to write reference prompts for finalized characters, locations, and props Use $short-drama-storyboard to break EP001 into shots and write first-frame prompts Use $short-drama-video-prompts to turn each shot into a video prompt (optionally grouping short adjacent shots into GROUP-* multi-shot prompts) # When targeting a specific video model with cross-shot consistency, state how references are bound: Use $short-drama-video-prompts to write EP001's video prompts for MiniMax H3; bind existing character, location, prop, and start-frame images in the project, list any missing ones, and do not fall back to text-to-video # When reference images are generated externally and stay out of the project, ask for a per-shot attach plan: Use $short-drama-video-prompts to write EP001's video prompts for MiniMax H3; I attach the reference images myself, so list per shot which images to attach, in what order, and what each governs # 4. Produce after explicit confirmation (single or batched, with resume support) Use $short-drama-produce to preview a batch of EP001's finalized image, video (including GROUP-* groups), voice, or music jobs; execute only after I confirm # 5. Cut into a finished episode Use $short-drama-edit to cut EP001's produced shots into an episode, stating the reason behind every in and out point # 6. Review on demand Use $short-drama-review to review EP001's script and prompts ``` Starting from a source novel when the first pass only needs text drafts: > Read `输入/story.txt`, list the core settings that must stay intact, character motivations, and reveals to hold back early on, then propose an episode breakdown rather than mapping one chapter per episode. For this pass, write EP001's script only and detail three key shots with start/end actions, hand poses, held props, and eyelines; deliver text drafts only without generating images, video, or audio. ## See what it produces The excerpts below come from files in this repository and real runs ("…" marks cuts). For the full set—source triage vs. full-pass comparison, setting payoff checklist, measured cut list, and model probes—see [Excerpts of real output](docs/real-outputs_EN.md). ### What an episode looks like In the public sample [*Let You Run the Account*, EP001](examples/creator-first/EP001/), one shot is handled layer by layer across four documents. The script records only dramatic action and dialogue (translated): ```markdown [OS] Someone from another army unit: The Rocket Force? Four accounts, four followers between them, right? Laughter pours out of the laptop's speaker. Behind the desk, Zhou Bosen sits bolt upright facing the screen, face set. In front of it, Jiang Chen, palms on the desk edge, snaps back to himself. ``` `视觉设定.md` (visual design) gives any look that must hold across shots a **continuity lock**, whose **locked phrase** pastes into prompts unchanged (translated): ```markdown - Continuity lock: LOCK-JIANGCHEN-DRESS "Jiang Chen's pine-green service uniform" (shots: SHOT-EP001-002, SHOT-EP001-003, SHOT-EP001-007, …; image prompt entry: IMG-JIANGCHEN-SHEET) · locked phrase: pine-green lapel service jacket ``` `分镜.md` (storyboard) sets the shot's start, end, and camera motivation; the **first-frame prompt** draws the opening frame alone, carrying the locked phrase verbatim (translated; prompt quoted as written): ```markdown ## SHOT-EP001-002 · Four accounts, four followers - Camera: slow push-in, starting at the loudest point of the laughter, past the back of the laptop toward the desk, stopping on Zhou Bosen's set face; the laughter is aimed at him. - Start: Zhou Bosen sits bolt upright facing the laptop, right hand beside his tea tumbler; Jiang Chen's palms rest flat on the glass edge, his eyes unfocused. - End: the frame settles on Zhou Bosen's set face in the screen glow; Jiang Chen still leans on the desk at the right edge. ### First-frame prompt > 9:16 vertical two-person medium shot in a present-day army arts-troupe office, framed at chest height: Jiangchen, a lean > young man in a pine-green lapel service jacket, stands mid-ground on frame right … with both palms flat on the glass and a > dazed, unfocused look; Zhoubosen, a broad square-faced middle-aged officer, sits bolt upright behind the desk … facing a > thin silver laptop whose lid faces the camera, … his right hand beside a double-walled glass tea tumbler on a dark round > coaster; … no text, no logo. ``` `视频提示词.md` (video prompts) writes only the motion and camera move from start to end, ready to paste as one block: ```markdown ## MOTION-EP001-002 · Four accounts, four followers ### Copyable prompt > … Laughter keeps pouring out of the laptop's small speaker. The seated officer's jaw tightens and his back straightens a > little more. The young man blinks once and his eyes snap into focus. At the loudest point of the laughter, the camera moves > steadily forward past the back of the laptop and stops when the seated officer's tight face fills the middle of the frame, > the young man remaining at the right edge. … ``` The four originals: [`剧本.md`](examples/creator-first/EP001/剧本.md) · [`视觉设定.md`](examples/creator-first/EP001/视觉设定.md) · [`分镜.md`](examples/creator-first/EP001/分镜.md) · [`视频提示词.md`](examples/creator-first/EP001/视频提示词.md). ### Missing entries and mismatches are flagged `creator_markdown_check.py` follows a **soft-gate principle**: only 100% deterministic mechanical checks (dangling cross-document IDs, missing asset files, duration mismatches, malformed slot syntax) emit blocking `ERROR`s, while heuristic checks emit non-blocking `WARNING`s for the agent to review. Breaking the sample in two places—misspelling `周薄森` as `周博森` in SHOT-002's on-screen settings (`出场设定`) and changing MOTION-003's duration from 2s to 3s—produces targeted errors: ```text ERROR: SHOT-EP001-002: 出场设定指向不存在的《视觉设定.md》条目: 人物「周博森」 ERROR: SHOT-EP001-003: 分镜时长 2 秒与视频提示词 3 秒不一致；视频提示词时长必须与分镜一致 ``` Line 1 flags that `出场设定` references a character name (`周博森`) that does not exist in `视觉设定.md`. Line 2 catches a duration mismatch between the 2-second storyboard shot and the 3-second video prompt. ## The twelve skills Invoke only the stages you need: text-only handoffs can stop at any stage, any existing draft can be reviewed on its own, and static motion comics go straight from first-frame images and voice-over to production and editing. ```mermaid flowchart LR classDef phase fill:#e8f4fd,color:#1a1a2e,stroke:#4a9be8,stroke-width:1px classDef final fill:#fce4ec,color:#333,stroke:#e57373,stroke-width:1px nva["Source analysis

Codex writes `$short-drama dashboard`): ``` /short-drama dashboard ``` Runs natively on macOS, Linux, WSL, and Windows. The server runs in the background with `--detach` so its link stays live across your session; `--status` prints the active URL and `--stop` shuts it down. It listens on loopback only and never uploads project files. When ready to hand off, `project_tool.py export --out ` packages each episode's existing five creator documents, `剪辑单.md`, and `制作成果/` into a delivery directory with a manifest and checksums (pass `--no-media` for a text-only handoff), and `project_tool.py verify ` re-checks the manifest and file checksums. ## FAQ ### Can I still get image-to-video prompts if I generate reference images in an external tool? Yes—that is the default workflow. When reference images are not stored in the project directory, the storyboard writes a per-shot attachment plan and video prompts are still generated for image-to-video, listing which images to attach per shot, in what order, and what each governs; local image files are only needed when `$short-drama-produce` calls a provider API directly. See the [Comic-drama workflow guide](docs/comic-drama-workflow.md) (Chinese). ### A video job was interrupted after submission. Should I resubmit it? Recover the existing job first to avoid paying twice. Bundled provider adapters write each job ID to disk as soon as it is accepted; have `$short-drama-produce` run `audit` to locate unfinished jobs and `collect` to fetch completed outputs. Only preview and confirm a retry after confirming the original job failed permanently on the provider side. See [Confirmed production](skills/short-drama-produce/SKILL.md) (Chinese). ### Do I need a GPU? How is media generation billed? No GPU is needed. Scripts, storyboards, and prompts use your coding agent's model, while local scripts handle indexing, checks, production handoffs, and edit rendering (`ffmpeg` / `ffprobe` on `PATH` for rendering cuts). Media generation calls external APIs with keys you configure outside the project and is billed by those providers, running only after you confirm each preview. ### Do static motion comics (keyframe cuts + voice-over) need video prompts? No. Storyboard first-frame prompts and image prompts go straight to production preview, voice-over, and editing, skipping the video-prompt stage. See the [Comic-drama workflow guide](docs/comic-drama-workflow.md) (Chinese). ### What do I do after upgrading? Re-run the same install command to update the skills. When upgrading an older project across field or rule changes, follow the upgrade notes in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md), then run `creator_markdown_check.py` on each episode (plus `edit_tool.py check` on edited episodes) to verify everything passes. ## Acknowledgments ## Part of ZenStory AI This project is maintained by [ZenStory AI](https://zenstory.ai) — open-source, agent-native tools for creating, adapting, and producing stories (GitHub org: [zenstory-ai](https://github.com/zenstory-ai)).
